title: Adaptive Notch Filter
version: Simulink Control Design documentation, R2026b; introduced R2026a
locator: Adaptive notch filter adjusts frequency, depth and width based on resonance identification or user-defined target
notes: Official block documentation for one software tool's adaptive notch implementation. It is used only to frame the possibility of adaptive notch strategies; it does not imply this block exists in a CNC drive.
